items.title: Money20/20 USA: DriveWealth CRO Rohit Mahna on round-the-clock global investing
items.summary: If you’re an investor in Thailand, the US market opens while you’re asleep. That’s starting to change. Rohit Mahna, Chief Revenue Officer at DriveWealth, sits down with JD Durkin at Money 20/20 USA in Las Vegas to explain how the move to 23-hour trading, and eventually 24/7, is opening US markets to investors around the world on their own schedule. Mahna shares how DriveWealth powers investing for more than 100 banks, fintechs and neobanks in about 30 countries, handling everything under the hood from settlement and custody to clearing and compliance. Fresh off a world tour, he describes a massive rise in retail investing across the Middle East, India, Southeast Asia and Latin America, where new investors want fractional shares, access inside the apps they already use and blue chip names like Tesla and Nvidia. He also looks ahead to how AI can help first-time investors become more educated, and why the firms that balance innovation with compliance will win.

items.title: Money 20/20 USA: Blockaid CEO Ido Ben-Natan on why stolen crypto rarely returns
items.summary: More than $1.1 billion has been stolen in major crypto hacks this year, and victims have recovered less than 1% of it. Ido Ben-Natan, Co-Founder and CEO of Blockaid, sits down with JD Durkin at Money 20/20 USA in Las Vegas to explain why. Ben-Natan breaks down what makes digital assets so different from other cyber targets: once attackers gain access, they can move funds in seconds, and with no physical asset to reclaim, recovery becomes nearly impossible, even when the stolen money is sitting in known wallets. He shares how Blockaid, which works with companies like Coinbase, Kraken, Gemini, Fidelity and BNY, stops attacks before they happen by simulating transactions and flagging risks before anyone signs. He also explains why the biggest emerging threat is speed and volume, with security teams now facing incidents every day and only seconds or minutes to respond.

Fuloria shares how Fundbox partners with platforms like QuickBooks, Stripe and SoFi, plus about 30 more, to offer loans, lines of credit and cash advances inside the tools small businesses use every day. He breaks down what embedded lending really means, with everyday examples like getting paid on invoices immediately or getting breathing room on supply purchases.
